desc: Derive the DP recurrence: prefix sums S (nums), C (cost); dp[i][r] = min cost partitioning first r elements into i segments; dp[i][r] = min_{l<r} dp[i-1][l] + (S[r] + k*i) * (C[r] - C[l]).
Expand transition into CHT form: dp[i][r] = (S[r]+k*i)*C[r] + min_{l<r} (dp[i-1][l] - (S[r]+k*i)*C[l]); lines with slope m = -C[l], intercept b = dp[i-1][l], queried at x = S[r]+k*i.
Implement monotone CHT (deque of lines, decreasing slopes, increasing query x, minimum query) using integer cross-multiplication for eviction tests.
Implement the layer loop: for i in 1..n, sweep r = i..n while inserting lines for l = i-1..r-1 from dp[i-1]; compute dp[i][r]; track answer as min of dp[i][n]. Use rolling arrays for O(n) space.
Verify against Example 1 (110) by hand-trace; check edge case n=1 → (nums[0]+k)*cost[0]; confirm unreachable (INF) states are correctly skipped in hull insertion.
Cross-check the CHT DP against a brute-force O(n^3) DP on small random inputs (3000+ trials matched; Example 2 yields 985).
Finalize code in starter format with imports (List from typing, deque from collections); O(n^2) time / O(n) space fits n=1000.
